run_inspect_data_cli: run the inspect_data CLI to visualize tokenized text samples from a data folder with rich formatting
run_inspect_data_with_reader: run inspect_data with a specific reader type like jsonl, parquet, csv, or warc to load data files
run_inspect_data_with_sampling: run inspect_data with a sample rate to randomly view a percentage of data samples
run_inspect_data_with_filtering: run inspect_data with a filtering expression to display only samples matching a condition
run_inspect_data_with_labeling: run inspect_data with a label output path to classify samples as good or bad and save results
